questions.question: How did Mordecai react to the decree against the Jews?
options: He fled away from the city to a far-off province
He tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and wailed
He offered a large bribe to win Haman over to him
He did nothing at all and waited very quietly
questions.answer: He tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and wailed

questions.question: What famous reason did Mordecai give for Esther to act?
options: Perhaps she had come to the kingdom for such a time as this
The king would surely listen to so fair and so lovely a queen
No one else in the whole palace would dare to speak up
Her own people would reward her richly with great honor
questions.answer: Perhaps she had come to the kingdom for such a time as this
